metadata.title: NASA Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) mission dataset
metadata.sourcePolicy: NASA official sources only; unknown values are represented as the string TBD.
metadata.coordinateConvention: Latitude and longitude in decimal degrees; east longitude positive; west longitude negative.
metadata.statusNote: Mission status describes delivery/landing outcome, not the operational status of each individual payload.

missions.name: Astrobotic Peregrine Mission One
missions.missionStatus: Failed to land; spacecraft did not reach the lunar surface

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array (LRA)
payloads.purpose: Provides a fiducial marker for precision laser ranging between lunar assets.

payloads.name: Neutron Spectrometer System (NSS)
payloads.purpose: Measures hydrogen-bearing materials and bulk lunar regolith composition.

payloads.name: Linear Energy Transfer Spectrometer (LETS)
payloads.purpose: Measures the lunar radiation environment.

payloads.name: Near InfraRed Volatile Spectrometer System (NIRVSS)
payloads.purpose: Measures surface/subsurface hydration and volatile-related composition.

payloads.name: Peregrine Ion-Trap Mass Spectrometer (PITMS)
payloads.purpose: Characterizes volatile species in the lunar exosphere.

missions.payloadCaveat: NASA's updated manifest lists five payloads for the flight; other originally considered payloads were reallocated to future missions.

missions.name: Intuitive Machines IM-1 (Odysseus)
missions.missionStatus: Landed; lander came to rest in a tilted orientation

payloads.name: Lunar Node 1 Navigation Demonstrator (LN-1)
payloads.purpose: Demonstrates lunar navigation and communications networking.

payloads.name: Stereo Cameras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies (SCALPSS)
payloads.purpose: Images lander engine plume interactions with the lunar surface.

payloads.name: Radio-wave Observations at the Lunar Surface of the photo Electron Sheath (ROLSES)
payloads.purpose: Measures the near-surface electron sheath and low-frequency radio environment.

payloads.name: Navigation Doppler Lidar for Precise Velocity and Range Sensing (NDL)
payloads.purpose: Measures lander velocity and altitude during descent.

payloads.name: Radio Frequency Mass Gauge (RFMG)
payloads.purpose: Measures cryogenic propellant quantity in the lander's tanks.

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array (LRA)
payloads.purpose: Provides a passive fiducial for precision laser ranging.

missions.name: Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 1
missions.missionStatus: Successfully landed; completed lunar surface mission

payloads.name: Next Generation Lunar Retroreflector (NGLR)
payloads.purpose: Supports precision laser ranging between Earth and the Moon.

payloads.name: Radiation Tolerant Computer System (RadPC)
payloads.purpose: Demonstrates computing techniques resilient to radiation-induced faults.

payloads.name: Regolith Adherence Characterization (RAC)
payloads.purpose: Studies how lunar dust adheres to different materials.

payloads.name: Lunar Magnetotelluric Sounder (LMS)
payloads.purpose: Studies lunar crustal and magnetic/electrical properties.

payloads.name: Lunar Environment Heliospheric X-ray Imager (LEXI)
payloads.purpose: Images Earth's magnetosphere in X-rays.

payloads.name: Lunar Instrumentation for Subsurface Thermal Exploration with Rapidity (LISTER)
payloads.purpose: Investigates lunar subsurface thermal properties and heat flow.

payloads.name: Lunar PlanetVac (LPV)
payloads.purpose: Demonstrates regolith sampling and pneumatic sample acquisition.

payloads.name: Stereo Cameras for Lunar Plume-Surface Studies (SCALPSS 1.1)
payloads.purpose: Images plume-surface interactions during landing.

payloads.name: Electrodynamic Dust Shield (EDS)
payloads.purpose: Demonstrates active lunar dust removal using electric fields.

payloads.name: Lunar GNSS Receiver Experiment (LuGRE)
payloads.purpose: Tests reception of GNSS signals at and near the lunar surface.

missions.name: Intuitive Machines IM-2 (Athena / PRIME-1)
missions.missionStatus: Landed; lander came to rest in a near-horizontal orientation; some surface objectives were not completed

payloads.name: TRIDENT (The Regolith Ice Drill for Exploring New Terrain)
payloads.purpose: Demonstrates drilling into lunar regolith to investigate subsurface volatiles.
payloads.outcomeNote: NASA PDS reports the drill could not complete its science objectives because the lander's orientation prevented the drill from reaching the surface.

payloads.name: MSolo (Mass Spectrometer observing lunar operations)
payloads.purpose: Identifies and quantifies volatiles released during lander and drilling operations.

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array (LRA)
payloads.purpose: Acts as a fiducial marker for precision laser ranging.
